question_part: Compares the annual number of motorist deaths with the annual number of cyclist deaths in NYC crashes.
metric: Annual reported motorist deaths and annual reported cyclist deaths, calculated by summing the respective killed-person columns across crash rows.
denominator: No denominator; absolute reported death counts.
population: All police-reported NYC motor vehicle crashes dated in calendar years 2013 through 2025; count the reported motorist/cyclist deaths on each crash row.
grouping: Calendar year and road-user type (motorist, cyclist).

initial_data_check.facts: The requested years each have crash rows; crash_date is missing on 0 rows in the file; each year has observed dates from January 1 through December 31; the two killed-person columns each have 0 missing values in the target population and in every year.
initial_data_check.meaning_and_decisions: No target-year crash rows or annual death entries are excluded for missingness. Keep all target-year rows and disclose that values are reported fatality counts. Full-year endpoints support treating each requested calendar year as covered, although endpoints alone do not establish that every date is represented. No columns in this plan are string-grouped, so empty/unknown category labels and default category values do not apply.

limitations: The chart compares reported counts, not per-capita, per-trip, or per-crash risk; no exposure denominator is available. Annual date endpoints span each full calendar year, but the check does not verify daily completeness or validate non-NULL death values.
